text:
Yes. Monzo offers **arranged overdrafts** to eligible UK personal-account customers, subject to approval.

- **Interest:** a variable **19%, 29% or 39% EAR** (the rate depends on your circumstances; many customers are offered 39%).
- **No separate fee** for having or using the personal overdraft. Interest is calculated daily on the amount you owe and is usually charged on the **1st of each month**.
- **Example:** Monzo says borrowing **£1,200 for 30 days at 39%** would cost **£32.94**.

You can check your eligibility and personal rate in the Monzo app. An overdraft is short-term borrowing, so paying it back sooner reduces the interest.
